title: Structure-sheaf adic comparison transfers to finite étale covers of a Noetherian quasi-affine open
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], S a commutative ring, f:R→S a ring map, I=ker(f), and V an open of Spec(R) [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Define V_n=V×_{Spec(R)}Spec(R/I^(n+1)), with projection v_n to V and transitions u_n:V_n→V_(n+1) induced by the quotient maps. Assume that every family t_n in Γ(V_n,O) with u_n^sharp(t_(n+1))=t_n is v_n^sharp(a) for a unique a in Γ(V,O). For every finite étale cover P→V [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], put P_n=P×_{Spec(R)}Spec(R/I^(n+1)), with projections p_n and transitions w_n. Then each family s_n in Γ(P_n,O) with w_n^sharp(s_(n+1))=s_n is p_n^sharp(b) for a unique b in Γ(P,O). No local, depth, power-series, constant-rank or surjectivity assumption on f is required.

proof.text: V is Noetherian and quasi-affine because it is an open of a Noetherian affine scheme. The finite étale map P→V is finite, flat and finitely presented, so its direct image E of O_P is finite locally free.

O_V is ample on the quasi-affine scheme. The dual of E is finite type, so finitely many global generators give a surjection O^r→E dual. Dualizing, locally where E is free, gives a universally injective E→O^r whose cokernel C is locally free. Repeat for C and compose to obtain 0→E→O^r→O^s, universally exact at the first two terms. This uses the construction in Stacks 0EKP, (2)→(3), with the ample bundle O_V.

Pull back this universally exact sequence to every V_n. Sections express Γ(V,E) and Γ(V_n,E|V_n) as kernels of the maps between the respective finite powers of scalar section rings. The scalar comparison hypothesis gives bijections on these powers, and the matrices defining the sheaf map commute with restrictions. Given a compatible family in the latter kernels, lift its coordinates uniquely using scalar comparison; its image in O^s vanishes because it vanishes at every index, and scalar uniqueness detects zero. This yields existence and uniqueness in Γ(V,E).

Finite affine base change identifies E|V_n with the direct image of O_(P_n) along P_n→V_n. Direct-image sections are the sections of the total space, and the base-change identification respects the projections and transitions. The preceding kernel bijection therefore has exactly the stated coverMap and coverTransition equalities. Empty opens and rank-zero or variable-rank covers are included.

theorem finiteEtale_adic_sections_comparison_of_structureSheaf
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (f : R →+* S) (V : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hscalar : ∀ s : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening f V n, ⊤),
      (∀ n, (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningTransition f V n).appTop
        (s (n + 1)) = s n) →
      ∃! a : Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤), ∀ n,
        (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap f V n).appTop a = s n)
    (P : V.toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (s : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.cover f V P n, ⊤))
    (hs : ∀ n, (FiniteEtale.Adic.coverTransition f V P n).appTop
      (s (n + 1)) = s n) :
    ∃! a : Γ(P.obj.left, ⊤), ∀ n,
      (FiniteEtale.Adic.coverMap f V P n).appTop a = s n
